# Not The Rug

> Not The Rug is a dog walking company in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, founded in 2011 by Luis. It offers group dog walks (up to three dogs, 45 minutes), puppy visits, senior and special-needs visits, and boarding and dog sitting. Walkers are background-checked, the business is fully insured and bonded, every walk is GPS-tracked, and clients get an update after every visit. New clients start with a free Meet & Greet.

## Key facts
- Service area: Williamsburg, Brooklyn, NY 11211. Based in North Williamsburg; covers North Williamsburg and much of South Williamsburg. Some blocks depend on staff availability.
- Address: 281 N 7th St, Ste 13, Brooklyn, NY 11211 (between Havemeyer St and Meeker Ave)
- Phone / text: (347) 610-9676
- Email: luis@nottherug.com
- Response hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–7 PM, Sat–Sun 10 AM–4 PM. Typical reply within 4 hours on weekdays.
- Dog walking: 45-minute walks, max 3 dogs. One dog: $33 per walk for 9 or more walks a month, $35 for 8 or fewer. Two dogs, same household: $48 / $50.
- Puppy visits: $35 per visit
- Senior & special-needs visits: $25 per visit
- Boarding & dog sitting: $100–$110 per day
- Reviews: 4.9 on Google (51 reviews), 5.0 on Yelp (37 reviews)
